html:
U²-Net (University of Alberta, Pattern Recognition 2020): finds the main object of a photo and cuts it out as a soft mask at 320 x 320 (rembg's default background remover); a full model, a 4.7 MB small one and one trained on people. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: U²-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object Detection, Pattern Recognition 2020, 2020-05-18
  • Original code: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net at ac7e1c817eca
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net/blob/ac7e1c817ecab7c7dff5ce6b1abba61cd213ff29/LICENSE ; https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net/blob/ac7e1c817ecab7c7dff5ce6b1abba61cd213ff29/README.md
  • Training data: DUTS (salient object detection) (README / paper: trained on DUTS-TR (10553 images).)
    • u2net-human-seg: Supervisely Person Dataset (human segmentation) (README (2021-Feb-06): the human segmentation model, trained on the Supervisely Person Dataset.)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, igev, cutlass_conv
  • Variants: u2net, u2netp, u2net-human-seg
  • Outputs: alpha
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): u2net 3000x4000 (0.8 GiB peak allocated, 1.0 reserved); u2netp 3000x4000 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 1.0 reserved); u2net-human-seg 3000x4000 (0.8 GiB peak allocated, 1.0 reserved)
  • u2net 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 36 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 36 s (ONNX + engine).
  • u2netp 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 30 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 26 s (ONNX + engine).
  • u2net-human-seg 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 36 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 35 s (ONNX + engine).
  • u2net original 1080x1920: xuebinqin/U-2-Net@ac7e1c817eca, float pre- and post-processing
  • u2netp original 1080x1920: xuebinqin/U-2-Net@ac7e1c817eca, float pre- and post-processing
  • u2net-human-seg original 1080x1920: xuebinqin/U-2-Net@ac7e1c817eca, float pre- and post-processing
  • u2net load / first call: original 0.64 s / 0.396 s, portable 0.49 s / 0.21 s, kernels 1.37 s / 0.109 s
  • u2netp load / first call: original 0.18 s / 0.474 s, portable 0.11 s / 0.261 s, kernels 1.28 s / 0.113 s
  • u2net-human-seg load / first call: original 0.54 s / 0.383 s, portable 0.32 s / 0.297 s, kernels 1.37 s / 0.113 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size against its binary mask: MAE of the alpha, max F-beta (beta^2 = 0.3) over 256 thresholds (BiRefNet's evaluation). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
